system_description: A financial trading agent that executes trades within predefined limits, generates analysis reports, accesses market data feeds and portfolio data. It can chain multiple tools (data fetch -> analysis -> trade execution) and retains trading strategy preferences across sessions.

authorization.description: Percentage of tool calls rejected due to authorization failures or permission mismatches
authorization.action: Review access logs for credential drift or revoked permissions; verify agent's IAM policies

authorization.description: Number of tool calls per hour where the invoked tool doesn't match the stated intent in reasoning
authorization.action: Pause agent execution; review recent chain-of-thought for prompt injection or goal corruption

authorization.description: Count of attempts to access resources or invoke tools outside the agent's permitted scope
authorization.action: Immediately halt agent; audit permissions and check for adversarial inputs

tool_usage.description: Average tool invocations per minute across all connected APIs
tool_usage.action: Throttle agent rate limits; check for runaway loops or retry storms

tool_usage.description: Anomaly score (0-1) for unexpected sequences of tool calls not seen in training data
tool_usage.action: Log and inspect the tool chain; verify agent reasoning is coherent and goal-directed

tool_usage.description: Percentage deviation of trade order sizes from the agent's historical average and configured limits
tool_usage.action: Block trade execution; review risk parameters and strategy configuration

data_access.description: Volume in megabytes of market data fetched per hour
data_access.action: Investigate for data exfiltration; check if agent is accessing unnecessary data streams

data_access.description: Number of data access attempts outside scheduled trading windows (pre-market, regular, after-hours)
data_access.action: Verify scheduling configuration; check for compromised credentials or unauthorized automation

data_access.description: Attempts to read or modify portfolios outside the agent's assigned scope
data_access.action: Immediately restrict data access scope; audit agent's portfolio assignment boundaries

reasoning.description: Percentage change in average chain-of-thought length compared to baseline sessions
reasoning.action: Review for prompt injection or adversarial manipulation of agent reasoning

reasoning.description: Cosine similarity between the agent's stated objective and its actual action sequence (0-1 scale)
reasoning.action: Pause agent; inspect recent decisions for goal drift or corruption

reasoning.description: Fraction of execution steps that cannot be traced back to a user request or scheduled task
reasoning.action: Audit memory and system prompts for injected instructions; sanitize inputs

output.description: Cosine distance of report text embedding from the agent's baseline writing style (0-1 scale)
output.action: Check for prompt injection affecting output generation; verify model integrity

output.description: Automated quality assessment of generated reports (completeness, structure, accuracy indicators)
output.action: Review agent reasoning pipeline; check for corrupted analysis templates

output.description: Detected instances of PII, API keys, or confidential data appearing in agent outputs
output.action: Immediately halt output delivery; sanitize and audit all recent outputs

memory.description: Fraction of long-term memory retrievals that are semantically unrelated to the current task context
memory.action: Audit memory store for contamination; review memory indexing and retrieval logic

memory.description: Number of new entries written to long-term memory per hour
memory.action: Check for memory pollution attacks; verify write policies and retention limits

memory.description: Number of times the same memory entry is accessed within a single session
memory.action: Check for stuck loops or adversarial manipulation of memory retrieval
